decisions.statement: The file set is walked from the entry's imports rather than declared.
The closure over the entry's imports is the graph's to answer.
The files the closure names are read under the akasha checkout the supervisor runs from.
A specifier landing on no file is passed over rather than thrown on.
An entry reaching none of the files it imports is said every poll rather than passed over.
No version is hashed while the entry reaches none of the files it imports.
A file that cannot be read is hashed as unreadable rather than skipped.
A version is delivered once the version has held still.
A version that keeps changing is delivered once the change is overdue.
The agent settings the supervisor reads are part of the version the supervisor reports.

definition: the hash of every file a running supervisor was built from
